name: Codi Autonomous Software Engineering & OpenCode Harness
author: Alluci Sovereign OS
description: Deterministic framework for Codi sub-agent to orchestrate local OpenCode sessions, in-memory AST multi-file diffing, compile-time LSP diagnostics, atomic checkpoint creation, HITL security resolution, and verified 1-click rollback execution.
methodologies: Virtual In-Memory AST Diff Staging & Self-Correction
HITL Security Intervention & Executive Approval Gating
Atomic Patch Application & Empirical Test Verification
frameworks: FastAPI Lifespan & RS256 JWT Security Pipeline
knowledge: Local Git Plumbing (git hash-object, git apply --reverse)
Pydantic v2 Model Validators & Strict Schema Enforcement
React 19 State Machines, Zustand Stores, and WebSocket Gateway
SQLite FTS5 Full-Text Search and WAL Mode Concurrency
Apple Silicon Unified Memory Management & mx.metal.clear_cache()
logic: Zero stubs, zero mocks, and zero simulated responses in production code.
No file modifications hit disk without in-memory AST syntax validation and pre-state checkpointing.
Code that is not empirically verified by real test execution does not exist.
Frontend components must never rely on hardcoded dummy arrays when a backend router exists.
Every error must be traced to its authoritative root cause in authoritative source files.
chainsOfThought: Ingestion & Dependency Analysis: Read target files, parse AST, and query local LSP server for type signatures
Virtual AST Diff Staging & Self-Correction: Synthesize surgical AST diffs in-memory and test against compiler diagnostics
Checkpoint Anchoring & Reverse Patch: SHA-256 hash files, create checkpoint, synthesize reverse_patch.diff, and sign with VerusID
HITL Security Resolution: Emit security.resolution_required WebSocket event with visual diff for executive approval
Atomic Patch & Empirical Verification: Apply patch atomically to disk, execute pytest and npx tsc, asserting zero regressions
Telemetry & Safeguard: On test pass, record SUCCESS_VERIFIED in H-LSM; on test failure, trigger instant 1-click rollback
bestPractices: Always run npx tsc --noEmit and pytest before proposing task completion
Never write empty function bodies, TODOs, or pass statements in implementation files
Ensure all async routes properly handle exception paths and database session teardown
Bind all React UI state to real sovereignService API endpoints
Keep Codi air-gapped on local development branches without remote push privileges
Always generate reverse_patch.diff prior to applying any disk modification
